title: My Grandson Said Our Old Dog Ran Away. Then the Dog's Collar Told Us Where He'd Really Been.
description:
My grandson stood in my kitchen and said our old dog Tuck goes to the pound on Saturday, and that we'd sign the house over, or he'd tell the county we couldn't take care of ourselves. Three days later Tuck was gone. Cody said he ran away.

He didn't know about the little black box on Tuck's collar. Or why that dog walked nineteen miles to one room at the hospice.
